title: C400GT Premium Maxi (Rally Edition)
description: The BMW Motorrad C400GT Premium Maxi (Rally Edition) is crafted for flickable urban agility and stoplight-to-stoplight punch, positioned in the Urban Roadster segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 400cc engine generating 44 HP and 38 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 163 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Upright Neutral riding stance and a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
